circular-flat-curve.alt: A car on a flat curve seen from above, with velocity tangent to the road and acceleration toward the center of the curve. Beside it, the free-body diagram seen from behind: F_N, road on car, up and F_g, Earth on car, down, equal; F_f, road on tires, horizontal toward the center. Static friction supplies the centripetal net force; no separate centripetal arrow is drawn.

vertical-loop-fbd.alt: A cart on the inside of a vertical loop. At the top, both F_g, Earth, and F_N, track, point down toward the center: F_g + F_N = mv²/r. At the bottom, F_N, track, points up and is longer than F_g, Earth, down: F_N − F_g = mv²/r. No separate centripetal force arrow is drawn.
